notes: The two supplied *the*s in *the four corners of the land* are placed by counting the ASV's articles against the one present article morpheme (rule 29): הָ on אָרֶץ takes the *the* before its own word and כַּנְפוֹת takes the supplied one. The competing reading gives that *the* to the numeral it stands before; the unit note records it.
Variant WLC.EZK.7.2.v001 is underdetermined and compatible with the base reading, so rule 53 is not engaged.
אֲדֹנָי takes a rule 15 supplied *the* and its frozen suffix is unrepresented; both occurrences of קֵץ are separately rendered, so rule 22 does not apply.
